command: set -euo pipefail; DB=/home/ai-core-node/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db; test -f "$DB"; echo '===DB==='; stat -c '%n|%s|%y' "$DB"; echo '===SCHEMAS==='; for t in datei artikel fundort anreicherung artikel_suchtext durable_memory retrieval_episodes_semantisch memory_tabelle mv_prestage_turns; do echo TABLE=$t; sqlite3 -readonly "$DB" "PRAGMA table_info('$t');" 2>/dev/null || true; echo COUNT=$(sqlite3 -readonly "$DB" "SELECT count(*) FROM '$t';" 2>/dev/null || echo NA); done; echo '===FILE_ORIGIN_SAMPLE==='; sqlite3 -readonly -separator '|' "$DB" "SELECT * FROM datei LIMIT 5;" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-700 || true; echo '===FUNDORT_SAMPLE==='; sqlite3 -readonly -separator '|' "$DB" "SELECT * FROM fundort LIMIT 5;" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-700 || true; echo '===OLLAMA==='; timeout 15 ollama list 2>&1 || true; echo OLLAMA_RC=$?; systemctl is-active ollama 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl --user is-active ollama 2>/dev/null || true; echo AUDIT_DONE=1
